summary: MSGS Spinco, Inc., the spin-off vehicle to be renamed MSG Rangers Corp., filed an 8-K reporting that its Form 10 registration statement became effective October 9, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. New York City time, and that Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. expects to distribute all Spinco common stock at 11:59 p.m. on October 26, 2026 to holders of record October 20, 2026. The Information Statement dated October 9, 2026 will be mailed to stockholders; shares will list on NYSE as MSGR. Joseph M. Cohen was appointed to the board and audit and compensation committees. Watch distribution mechanics and when-issued trading.
